name: dash_router
description: URL state components (UrlParam, UrlCommit) for dash-router

scripts.build:backends: rm -rf dash_router && mkdir dash_router && uv run --with pyyaml --project . dash-generate-components ./src/ts/components dash_router -p package.json --ignore \.test\. && rm -f dash_router/package.json dash_router/proptypes.js && mkdir -p src/dash_router/_components && find src/dash_router/_components -type f ! -name __init__.py -delete && mv dash_router/* src/dash_router/_components/ && rmdir dash_router
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:backends
